This is my main plot, and maize is what feeds my household, so I must do what I can. I will try to get one bag of the government NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer to spread on this plot, but money is short so it will not be much. I will plant the maize seed I kept from last harvest because it is what I have, and I do not trust those expensive new seeds. My family will do all the work by hand—weeding twice and harvesting ourselves—because hiring labor is too costly for only this small plot of less than one hectare.
